scenario: At a café dessert counter: ask for a menu, order a slice of cake, request a fork, request an extra plate for sharing, ask whether a dessert contains nuts, and ask which desserts are available without milk. Avoid tasks from previous café episodes: greetings, coffee quantities or temperature, adding milk, takeaway, water, ice, cup return, phone charging, prices and drink replacement. Make each context explicit and keep the final task a hard beginner comment bonus.
audience: English-speaking adults learning practical beginner Korean
level: Beginner: two easy, two medium and two relatively hard questions, with polite requests and simple ingredient questions
